digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter outbound comment send path
propositions: DC outbound add_comment passes comment body unfit to the Jira client, violating the deployment-resolved comment_max_chars ceiling and causing over-length decorated comments to be rejected and re-emitted on every sync pass
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production caller; the marker-preserving fit logic fit_comment_as_sent is wired only in the diff half of convergence, not the send half
After fitting, the dedup key (_DCSanitizer.fit_comment) must equal the marker-stripped body the send actually lands; currently it does not track the real send composition

Cloud's dead _JiraSanitizer.sanitize_comment chain (method, jira_fields delegate, acli facade, protocol member) must be removed because a plain 32767-char cap would truncate RECONCILER_MARKER if wired, reintroducing bug 5931
